svg.title: TerraGate system map: evidence-backed Terraform review without deployment authority
svg.desc: A reviewer submits a bounded plan through a Next.js and OpenNext interface on Cloudflare Workers. API Gateway routes to Lambda running FastAPI through Mangum, where deterministic Python checks inspect the plan. Neon stores snapshot-bound findings, evidence, decisions, and audit history. A scoped risk exception and comment approval are separate human decisions. GitHub writes are mocked and Terraform execution is disabled in the public demo. Raw plan files in Lambda temporary storage can expire.
svg.text: Review the exact plan. Keep approval bounded.
Findings, evidence, and human decisions stay attached to the same saved snapshot.
Each decision is scoped to saved evidence
Plan changes reset prior approval; comment review and risk exceptions are separate records.

text.tspan: can expire; retrieval can return HTTP 410.

g.text: DURABLE STORAGE IS A PRODUCTION STEP

text.tspan: is separate from this AWS image path.

svg.text: Next.js / OpenNext · Cloudflare Workers · API Gateway · Lambda / FastAPI / Mangum · Neon · CodeBuild / ECR · GitHub Actions
The RDS / private-VPC Terraform stack is a reference alternative, not the deployed demo architecture.
Shared development identities · GitHub writes mocked · Terraform execution disabled · no merge enforcement
Risk acceptance records a bounded human decision; it never approves deployment.
